status: registered before any Previous Runs forecast was downloaded or scored (only a 3-day availability probe was made)
purpose: Go/no-go on proposing a (still inactive) correction of the Open-Meteo forecast rain / wind used by the advisory rules. Everything else in the run is descriptive.

truth.qc: per variable: a row is dropped for variable v only when qc_flags contains 'v;'. No hz-cal QC list existed when registered.
truth.rain6h: rain6h_mm at 00/06/12/18 UTC = total over the 6 h ending at obs_utc
truth.rain24h: rain24h_mm at 12 UTC only (19 local, VN climate day); it equals the sum of the four preceding rain6h (checked >= 99 %)
truth.rain72h: sum of three consecutive 12 UTC rain24h; all three needed

forecast.alignment: instantaneous vars at obs_utc; precipitation hour h = total of the preceding hour, so the window ending at H uses hours H-5..H (6 h) / H-23..H (24 h); all hours of a window must be non-null; one lead N for the whole window

candidates.additive: per station x model x lead x variable: forecast - mean(fc - obs) on fit
candidates.quantile_mapping: per station x model x lead x variable: empirical CDF mapping fc->obs on fit, 1st..99th + 99.5/99.9 percentiles, constant shift beyond the top fitted quantile, clipped at 0

primary_rules.rule: weather_advisory WATCH: wind >= 35 km/h = 9.72 m/s (on 3-hourly matched samples)

pooling: test samples pooled over the 5 stations and over the rule's leads (each lead counted separately)
min_events: observed events in the pooled test sample >= 30, else the rule is 'insufficient' (no-go, descriptive only)
go_rule_per_rule_and_candidate: go if ALL: CSI_corr - CSI_raw >= 0.05; |FB_corr - 1| < |FB_raw - 1|; FAR_corr <= FAR_raw + 0.02
continuous_secondary: additive wind: test MAE pooled leads 1-3 reduced >= 10 % at >= 4 of 5 stations (model best_match) -> 'go' for an additive wind term
decision: A correction is proposed as a versioned config (active=false) only for (rule, candidate) pairs that are 'go'. Otherwise the config records 'no-go' with the reason. Never activated here; weather stays observation-only (AGENTS.md rule 4). Transfer from coastal SYNOP stations to NB1 is NOT validated by this test.
sensitivity_descriptive: tail mapping with and without 2024-09-06..2024-09-08 (Yagi) in the fit
